answer: Public signal-table bond: every identity posts its work as a signed signal receipt to one public table. Its nebula of receipts is open for any peer to recompute. A random raven auditor re-checks five in a hundred; a failed receipt burns the poster's 70-credit bond and flags its cluster as a forged-signal ring. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits against a 40,000 pool; an honest agent posts once, keeps its bond, and earns its full share.
